availability.note: Lotus AU specifications page data lists ELETRE BASE (600 series, 603 hp/450 kW) as a current AU grade, price field blank; configurator is JS-only and did not render. CarsGuide 2026 VIC listing shows it available to order.

listPrice.note: CarExpert 24 Oct 2026: 'base Eletre ... starts at $189,990 plus on-road costs'. Same figure as CarsGuide 2026 MSRP (https://www.carsguide.com.au/lotus/eletre/price/2026). Lotus AU publishes no price; CarExpert Atlas shows $189,900, treated as a typo.

batteryKwh.note: usable 109.0 kWh; gross/nominal 111.9 kWh on the same page; CarExpert AU spec also gives 111.9 gross / 109 usable

rangeKm.note: Lotus AU: 'Range (WLTP) 535 - 600 km'; AU base ships on 20-inch wheels (CarExpert AU spec, 255/45 R20 + 285/45 R20) which is the 600 km case. EV Database TEL 373 mi = 600 km.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: WLTP combined 214 Wh/km on CarExpert AU spec; Lotus AU footnote gives 21.4-25.4 kWh/100km range-wide. 109/600 = 18.2, within tolerance (WLTP figure includes charging loss).

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: 'Rear seats up, to lower window 688 L' on CarExpert AU spec (to the window line = cargo-cover convention); frunk 46 L not added. EV Database gives 611 L (method unstated).

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: rear seats folded 1,532 L; matches EV Database max

seats.note: two front + three rear seats; EV Database also 5

towKg.note: 2,250 kg braked / 750 kg unbraked on CarExpert AU spec (JATO data); EV Database same. Lotus AU spec page does not publish towing.

warrantyYears.note: Lotus AU: 'standard 5-year or 150,000 km warranty'; HV battery 8 yr/200,000 km. CarExpert spec grids show 36 months, contradicted by Lotus's own page.

insuranceAnnual.note: Anchored to lotus-emeya-600 ($177,990, $4,600) and porsche-cayenne-phev-s-e-hybrid ($187,800, $3,800); Lotus premium for thin parts/repair network. Unchanged from held.

depreciationCurve.note: Single Lotus brand curve (owner convention), matching the held lotus-emeya-600 curve. Steeper than mainstream on documented evidence: MY25 factory cut of $35,010-$49,010 overnight, 21 AU sales across 2024-25 and 4 to Oct 2026 (CarExpert Atlas), five-showroom network. Previously Base and S carried two different curves.

listPrice.note: CarsGuide 2026 Eletre S $229,990, MSRP excluding stamp duty and government charges.
